summary: All five items are done, proven red before and green after, and committed on toggles-fixes in the scratch tree pt, by explicit blobs, without touching zone.html. (1) N6: build-toggle-design-v1 now says where a book page serves each switch: word senses in the row of pills; the default sources (a pill per source) and the second source (in the note under that row) on every book page the default picks reach; and the lede names the three. It checks those claims against the reader opened without ?rail=all and refuses a page that disagrees. It photographs each row scrolled to the top and refuses one that anything covers. With no --url it serves the tree itself (serve-tree-v1) instead of the typed port 8899. Built in scratch: the new row-defaults.png shows the whole sentence (viewed); HEAD's had the Home/Menu/Top/Chapter bar across it. (2) The readiness wait in five checks is now a fault after 30 s. Each was timed before and after on HEAD's page and goes red on a page that never says ready. (3) gloss-store-v1 escapes SIGN_GAP and the signs ¿ and × (14/14 probe lines answer as before). check-same-product-v1 imports SIGN_GAP, signOnly and signsOff from it. (4) check-default-picks-v1: D7 gains w5, found from data (Hosea, held halves outside a run). D20 recounts the named-row cells with the ledger. D5 holds the gap beside STEP's words over all 39 records in node mode. ready() now throws. The receipt was baked only in scratch. (5) The new tool compare-resting-lines-v1 runs in round-v1.sh after the lines step. Lint shows no new warnings, and the 3-way merge of every file with kinds-build over 46bbbf7d50 has 0 conflicts. Two files I changed (check-default-picks-v1, check-same-product-v1) also carry the page builder's uncommitted hunks. I committed only my own hunks (HEAD plus mine, staged by blob) and left theirs unstaged in the working files. Scratch servers 8975-8978 are stopped and the big scratch copies and shadow reader deleted.
